attrs.append-to: Teleport target container selector (CSS selector); the content node is appended into the target container while pinned (fixed positioning stays viewport-relative, escaping overflow clipping by ancestors) and moved back on unpin; a non-matching selector warns once and falls back to no teleport
attrs.position: Pin direction: top (default, pinned when the top edge reaches) / bottom (pinned when the bottom edge reaches); invalid values fall back to top
attrs.target: Scroll container selector (CSS selector); falls back to window scroll with a console warning when no element matches
attrs.z-index: Overrides the fixed layer z-index while pinned (non-negative integer; invalid falls back to token with a warning)

events.oas-change: Dispatched when the pin state flips; detail { fixed, top }: fixed indicates whether pinned; top is the reference pin position (offset for top pinning, the element's current rect.top for bottom pinning)

attrs.closeable: Whether to show the close button
attrs.icon: Show the default icon for the type (info/success/warning/error); override via slot="icon"
attrs.description: Secondary text below the title; rich content via slot="description"
attrs.variant: Visual variant: tint (default, light bg + matching border) / filled (solid type color + on-color text) / outlined (transparent bg + type color border)
attrs.banner: Banner mode: no border/radius, full-width; shows icon by default
attrs.center: Center the text area horizontally (title/description/body); often combined with banner
attrs.open: Controlled visibility (default true): set to false on close with oas-open-change dispatched; set true again to reopen
attrs.close-text: Close button text (replaces the default ✕); rich custom content via slot="close"
attrs.max-line: Max body lines: clamp with CSS line-clamp and show an expand/collapse toggle; not set = no clamping
attrs.prominent: Large icon: enlarge the icon one step (works with icon)
attrs.border: Accent bars: space-separated top/end/bottom/start (logical sides, RTL-aware) rendering a type-color bar
attrs.size: Size: small/medium/large (default medium) scaling font size and padding
attrs.title: Title text (rendered into the visible title region; absorbed from the host on read so no native hover tooltip remains; pass an empty string to clear); use the "title" slot for rich content

events.oas-open-change: Dispatched when visibility changes, detail { open }
events.oas-after-close: Dispatched after the closing transition ends (also dispatched when prefers-reduced-motion skips the transition)
events.oas-close: Dispatched after the close button is clicked; the component then hides

slots.title: Rich title content slot; overrides the title attribute text when present
slots.action: Right-side action slot (e.g. "View details"/"Undo" buttons); placed left of the close button when both present
slots.close: Rich custom close element, overrides ✕ and close-text; aria-label still falls back to close-text/locale
slots.description: Rich description slot; overrides the description attribute when present
slots.icon: Icon slot; overrides the default type icon

attrs.sections: Sections JSON: `[{ key, title?, items: [{ label, value? }] }]`; the letter rail is derived from sections (keys are unique, the first duplicate wins), `title` falls back to `key`, and an item's `value` falls back to `label`
attrs.height: Fixed height of the list area in px; when it overflows the list scrolls internally. When unset the list grows with its content and the scroll spy watches the viewport
attrs.sticky: Sticky section headers (default true); explicitly set `sticky="false"` to disable

events.oas-item-click: Fired when a list item is clicked, `detail: { value, label, section }` (`section` is the section key)
events.oas-change: Fired when the highlighted letter changes (via tap/drag jump or scroll linkage), `detail: { key }`; not fired on initial render

attrs.active: Currently highlighted href (controlled: external set/remove takes effect immediately; the scroll spy writes it back)
attrs.items: Anchor items JSON; items support `children` (multi-level nesting), `target` (e.g. `_blank`) and per-item `targetOffset`
attrs.offset: Highlight detection offset in px: how early a section's top crosses the detection line
attrs.scroll-container: Scroll container selector or element id; when unset the viewport (window) is used
attrs.target-offset: Click landing offset in px (avoids fixed headers); falls back to `offset` when unset; per-item `targetOffset` wins
attrs.affix: Enable affix (sticky positioning, sticks to the scroll viewport/container)
attrs.affix-offset: Distance from the scroll viewport top when affixed (px)
attrs.bounds: Trigger boundary (px, default 5): extra lead for a section's top crossing the detection line, avoids highlight flicker
attrs.block: Scroll landing alignment: `start` / `center` / `end` / `nearest` (does not scroll when the target is already fully visible — minimal scroll; aligns to top when above, to bottom when below)
attrs.hash: Whether clicking updates the URL hash (default true; `false` disables)
attrs.replace: History control: use `history.replaceState` instead of pushState
attrs.duration: Smooth scroll duration in ms (default 300; `0` jumps instantly)
attrs.size: Size: `small` / `medium` / `large`
attrs.variant: Style variant: `default` (rail + moving ink) / `underline` (sliding underline) / `lineless` (no axis) / `block` (filled background)
attrs.internal-scrollable: Make the anchor list itself internally scrollable (max-height + overflow-y: auto)
attrs.animation: Smooth scroll switch (default true; `false` jumps instantly)
attrs.get-current-anchor: Custom highlight strategy: attribute names a global function that receives the computed candidate href and returns the actual href to highlight; the `getCurrentAnchor` property also accepts a function

events.oas-change: Fired on highlight change (both click and scroll-driven), `detail: { href, prevHref }`
events.oas-click: Fired when a user clicks an anchor item (separate from the scroll-driven `oas-change`, so hosts can react to user actions only; also fires for external-link `target` items), `detail: { href, item }`

attrs.href: Anchor target: `#id` (or an external URL; combine with `target` for external links)
attrs.target: Link target (e.g. `_blank`): when set, the default browser behavior is not intercepted (`rel="noopener noreferrer"` is added automatically)
attrs.target-offset: Per-item click landing offset (px), overriding the global `target-offset`; invalid values are ignored

slots: Anchor item title content (default slot text; direct `oas-anchor-item` children are excluded)

attrs.id: Target marker id: synced to the inner `part=target` element, used by anchor items as the scroll landing target

slots: The marked target content (e.g. multi-level headings)

attrs.heading: Title text (attribute channel; use the title slot for rich content, which overrides this)
attrs.menu-button: Show the leading hamburger button; clicking it emits oas-menu-toggle (pair with a collapsible sidebar)
attrs.menu-open: Hamburger expanded state (controlled): the host writes back after toggling its drawer; the button aria-expanded stays in sync
attrs.menu-controls: Element id for the hamburger button aria-controls (none by default)
attrs.position: Positioning mode: static (default, in flow) / absolute / fixed / floating (floating rounded with shadow)
attrs.hide-on-scroll: Hide on scroll down, reveal on scroll up (transform transition, no reflow; effective only when not static)
attrs.extended-collapse-on-scroll: Collapse the extended section on scroll down (restored when scrolled back to top)
attrs.elevated: Show a shadow once the page is scrolled (no shadow at rest)

events.oas-menu-toggle: Emitted when the hamburger button is clicked; the host toggles its drawer and writes back menu-open

slots.actions: Right-side action area; overflow items auto-collapse into the overflow panel and re-dispatch to the original buttons
slots.extended: Second-row extended section (collapses on scroll with hide-on-scroll or extended-collapse-on-scroll)
slots.title: Rich title channel (overrides the heading attribute)

cssVars.--oas-glass-refraction: Liquid-glass edge refraction filter (active under `data-glass`, default none); for local opt-out override with an **empty** value (`--oas-glass-refraction: ;`)—not `none` (mixing `none` with button-state brightness() invalidates the whole filter declaration)

attrs.ratio: Aspect ratio: preset name `square` (1/1) / `landscape` (4/3) / `portrait` (3/4) / `wide` (16/9) / `ultrawide` (21/9) / `golden` (1.618/1), or a fraction `16/9`, `4:3`, `16 / 9`, decimal `1.5`; also assignable as a number property (`el.ratio = 1.5`). Token names match first; missing/invalid values (including zero numerator or denominator) fall back to `1 / 1` with a dev warning once per invalid value (deduplicated)

slots: Content that keeps the aspect ratio

attrs.message: Global default config JSON for the message imperative API (keys aligned with existing options: `duration`); imperative functions merge the nearest app's config with call options, call options win; invalid JSON is ignored with a dev warning
attrs.notification: Global default config JSON for the notification imperative API (keys aligned with existing options: `duration`/`showProgress`/`progressPosition`/`scrollable`); imperative functions merge the nearest app's config with call options, call options win; invalid JSON is ignored with a dev warning
attrs.toast: Global default config JSON for the imperative toast API (keys aligned with existing options keys: `duration`/`position`/`closable`/`priority`/`max`/`politeness`/`variant`/`showProgress`/`progressRing`/`swipeDirection`/`grouping`/`stacked`/`pauseOnHover`/`pauseOnFocus`/`pauseOnWindowBlur`); imperative calls merge the nearest app config with call arguments, call arguments win; invalid JSON is ignored with a dev warning

slots: Subtree (imperative message stacks mount inside this container instead of `document.body`)

attrs.clearable: Clearable (shows a clear button when the input has content; clearing dispatches `oas-clear` and an empty `oas-change`)
attrs.debounce: Input debounce (ms, default 0 = off): only debounces `oas-input` dispatch and filtering, never the input display
attrs.loading: Loading placeholder (dropdown shows a loading state; remote-suggestion request state)
attrs.options: Options, JSON array `[{ label, value, disabled?, group? }]` (group is the group title)
attrs.readonly: Readonly (focusable & copyable, not editable; focus and keyboard never open suggestions)
attrs.size: Size tier: small / medium / large (default medium, follows the nearest config-provider injection)
attrs.status: Validation status: success / warning / error (error syncs aria-invalid, drivable by oas-form-item validation)
attrs.trigger-on-focus: Show suggestions on focus (datalist mental model; off by default — input-first)
attrs.value: Preset value
attrs.required: Required marker (drives the native valueMissing validation chain; not passed through to the inner control)
attrs.variant: Visual variant: `outlined` (default) / `filled` / `borderless`; invalid values fall back silently
attrs.placement: 12-direction panel placement (engine flip/RTL result written to data-placement)
attrs.autofocus: Focuses the inner input after mounting
attrs.virtual: Virtual scrolling (renders only the visible window via oas-virtual-list; grouped options fall back to full rendering)
attrs.item-height: Fixed virtual row height in px (with virtual, default 36)

events.oas-clear: Clear button clicked, `detail: { value }` (value before clearing)
events.oas-option-render: Dispatched after each option row renders, `detail: { index, option, element }`; the host can rewrite `element` (icons/rich text)
events.oas-focus: Dispatched on focus with the current input text
events.oas-blur: Dispatched on blur with the current input text

slots.empty: Custom no-match empty state (replaces the default text)
slots.footer: Suggestion panel footer content (e.g. a view-all link)
slots.header: Suggestion panel header content (e.g. a hint bar)
slots.template[slot=\"option\"]: Custom option template skeleton; the `[data-option-label]` node auto-binds the option text

props.value: Current value: the visible text (the selected suggestion label after choosing); the `value` attribute is the `option.value`

attrs.badge: Badge text overlaid on the avatar's top-right corner; boolean form (no value) shows a dot
attrs.size: Size: number in px or enum alias `small`(24) / `medium`(32) / `large`(40)
attrs.src: Image URL; renders an image avatar when present
attrs.color: Text avatar background: semantic color / preset name / any color value (contrast text color auto-picked)
attrs.fallback: Fallback image URL: used when the main image fails (text/slot chain after that)
attrs.text: Text content: single char renders the first character; multiple chars render in full with auto-shrinking font
attrs.srcset: Responsive source descriptors passed through to the inner img (empty removes it)

events.oas-error: Fired when an image fails (once for the main src, once for the fallback), `detail: { src }`
events.oas-trigger: Change-avatar entry (trigger overlay) clicked; upload interaction is up to the host

slots.fallback: Custom placeholder content when the image fails to load (or the avatar has no content)
slots.icon: Icon avatar (explicit icon content; no first-character truncation)
slots.trigger: Custom content for the change-avatar overlay (shown on hover/focus; built-in camera icon by default)

attrs.max: Max number of avatars shown; overflow shows a `+N` count badge
attrs.size: Unified avatar size (px); the count badge adapts
attrs.spacing: Member spacing in px (negative = overlapping; overrides the `--oas-avatar-group-overlap` variable)

attrs.append-to: Teleport mount point: a CSS selector; on connect the component is moved under that container (kept in place when unset)
attrs.badge: Badge content: text/number shown in a small badge at the button's top-right corner
attrs.draggable: Drag positioning: press and drag to move the button freely (movement beyond 4px counts as a drag and does not trigger scroll-to-top; within 4px it counts as a click and still scrolls to the top). Position is persisted to localStorage (key `oas-back-top-pos`, clearable by the host to reset)
attrs.duration: Smooth-scroll duration (ms), default 400; 0 or `prefers-reduced-motion` jumps directly
attrs.expand: Full-width bar mode: the button spans the full viewport bottom (content centered horizontally); ignores `position` / `bottom` / `right`
attrs.position: 8-direction enum: `top-left` / `top-center` / `top-right` / `middle-left` / `middle-right` / `bottom-left` / `bottom-center` / `bottom-right`; replaces the numeric `bottom` / `right` positioning when set (`middle-*` vertically centers); invalid values silently fall back to `bottom` / `right`
attrs.reverse: Reverse mode: becomes a "scroll to bottom" button (hidden near the container bottom; clicking scrolls to the container bottom)
attrs.right: Distance from the viewport right edge
attrs.show-progress: Scroll progress ring: a progress ring around the button edge (SVG circle computed over the `target` container scroll range)
attrs.size: Size tier: `small` (32px) / `medium` (default, 40px) / `large` (48px)
attrs.target: Scroll target container: a CSS selector; when set the component listens to that container's scroll and scrolls back to its top/bottom; when unset it auto-detects the nearest scrollable ancestor (cached across disconnect/reconnect), falling back to window
attrs.theme: Theme variant: `light` (default, light) / `primary` (primary fill) / `dark` (dark surface, auto-inverted in dark theme to keep contrast)
attrs.tooltip: Hover hint text: shows a bubble tooltip on hover / keyboard focus
attrs.transition: Enter/exit transition: `fade` (default, fade in/out) / `scale` (zoom) / `none`; disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`
attrs.visibility-height: Scroll threshold (px): the button auto-shows once scrolled beyond it, default 400
attrs.visible: Controlled visibility: when present the host fully controls show/hide (scroll does not interfere); when absent the button auto-toggles by the scroll threshold

events.oas-click: The button was clicked (then scrolls to the target container top/bottom)
events.oas-visibility-change: Visibility state changed, `detail: { visible: boolean }` (dispatched on both controlled and uncontrolled switches; the initial sync on mount is not dispatched)

slots: Custom button content (replaces the built-in arrow icon when present)

attrs.open: Whether shown
attrs.close-label: aria-label of the screen-reader close button (sr-only by default, revealed on Tab focus so keyboard users can close the overlay); falls back to the locale `modal.close`
attrs.color: Overlay background color: any CSS color value, or one of the 11 preset names (`magenta`/`red`/`volcano`/`orange`/`gold`/`lime`/`green`/`cyan`/`blue`/`geekblue`/`purple`, mapped to `--oas-preset-*` tokens); falls back to `--oas-backdrop-bg` when unset
attrs.opacity: Overlay opacity: levels `thin` (0.35) / `default` (0.55) / `thick` (0.75) or a 0–1 number; applies to the scrim layer only (does not dim overlay content); invalid values fall back to `--oas-backdrop-opacity`
attrs.persistent: Persistent overlay: mask clicks do not emit `oas-click` (host-driven closing stops working); the content shakes instead as a not-closable hint
attrs.stop-propagation: Stop mask clicks from propagating into the host document (default true; `"false"` allows bubbling)

events.oas-click: Backdrop clicked, `detail.originalEvent` is the original click event
events.oas-after-close: Emitted after the close animation finishes (canonical, aligned with the after-* family); no `detail`. Scroll unlock and node removal (the element removes itself) happen after this
events.oas-after-show: Emitted after the enter animation finishes (canonical, aligned with the after-* family); no `detail`; emitted immediately under reduced motion

attrs.attention: Attention animation: `pulse` (an outward pulse ring; the pulse color follows the `--oas-badge-pulse-color` custom property, defaulting to the badge background) / `bounce` (slight up-and-down bounce); applies only to count / dot / standalone badges (the ribbon is unaffected) and is disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`
attrs.color: Badge color: the four semantic colors (`primary` / `success` / `warning` / `danger`), any CSS color value, or one of the 11 preset names (`magenta` / `red` / `volcano` / `orange` / `gold` / `lime` / `green` / `cyan` / `blue` / `geekblue` / `purple`, mapped to `--oas-preset-*` tokens, auto-brightened in dark). Applies uniformly across count / dot / ribbon; the solid text color is picked black/white by the background luminance for readability
attrs.corner: Corner placement: `top-right` (default) / `top-left` / `bottom-right` / `bottom-left`, affects count / dot corner badges only (the ribbon uses `placement`); `offset` fine-tunes in screen px on top of the corner result (x positive rightward, y positive downward, independent of the corner direction), corner first then shift, they compose; invalid values silently fall back to `top-right`
attrs.mode: Mode: `count` (default, numeric/dot badge) or `ribbon` (ribbon corner, same as `ribbon` attribute)
attrs.offset: Position fine-tune: `"x,y"` (px numbers, negative values allowed), shifts the corner badge or ribbon on top of its anchor position (x positive rightward, y positive downward); composes with `corner` / `placement` / `ribbon-vertical` (anchor first, then shift); invalid values (non-numeric, missing coordinate) are silently ignored
attrs.overlap: Circular inset: when wrapping circular content (e.g. an avatar), the badge tucks inside the circle edge (the translate amount shrinks from 50% to ~29%, the 1-√2/2 geometric inset); affects corner badge mode only
attrs.premium: Metallic treatment: a multi-stop gold gradient with a deep-gold fine outline (clipped shapes get the outline traced along their clip-path silhouette), text color auto-picked dark against the gold background; composes orthogonally with `color` with the priority `premium` > `color` > semantic default; works with every `ribbon-form`, dark theme adapts automatically (driven by the `--oas-preset-gold` token)
attrs.ribbon-anchor: Unified ribbon anchor, with the anchor set adapted per shape semantics: `fold` (left/right edge centers + four corners, a horizontal band hugs left/right with the vertical position adjustable), `diagonal`/`triangle` (four corners), `side` (left/right edge centers + four corners), `banner` (top/bottom), `seal` (all 8 positions), `bookmark` (four corners + four edge centers); an anchor pins the ribbon to an edge/corner (the fold notch auto-flips on bottom anchors) and `offset` fine-tunes any arbitrary position; when unset it falls back to the `placement` / `ribbon-position` / `ribbon-direction` / `ribbon-vertical` aliases, invalid values or unsupported anchor-shape combos silently fall back
attrs.ribbon-direction: Swallow-tail notch direction of `bookmark`: `down` (default, hangs from the top edge with the notch downward) / `left` (tab against the right edge with the notch pointing left) / `right` (tab against the left edge with the notch pointing right); physical-direction semantics (not flipped in RTL); only takes effect with `ribbon-form="bookmark"`, invalid values silently fall back to `down`
attrs.ribbon-form: Ribbon shape: `fold` (default, straight band + folded corner) / `diagonal` (45° diagonal band from the top corner; the band extends outside the card, so the host needs `overflow: hidden` to clip it) / `triangle` (a pure corner triangle holding a small icon or `slot="ribbon"` content) / `bookmark` (a vertical tab hanging from the top edge with a swallow-tail notch) / `side` (a vertical strip hung at mid-height of the side edge) / `seal` (a circular serrated stamp with centered text) / `banner` (a full-width strip across the top edge with angled ends) / `flag` (a side swallow-tail banner: a horizontal band with a V notch at the protruding end, always facing the protruding side) / `rounded` (rounded end) / `zigzag` (serrated end) / `arrow` (arrow-point end); the `ribbon-position` trio only affects `fold`, the other shapes have their own vertical placement, invalid values silently fall back to `fold`
attrs.ribbon-vertical: Vertical position of the side-mount `bookmark` forms (`ribbon-direction="left"` / `"right"`): `center` (default, vertically centered) / `top` (flush with the top edge) / `bottom` (flush with the bottom edge); only affects the side-mount forms, invalid values silently fall back to `center`
attrs.ribbon-position: Ribbon vertical position: `hang` (default, hangs below the top edge) / `edge` (flush with the top edge) / `cross` (straddles the top edge, pressing against the card border for the strongest wrap-around feel); orthogonal to `placement` (start / end), affects the `ribbon-form="fold"` shape only, invalid values silently fall back to `hang`
attrs.ribbon-size: Diagonal band size tier: `small` (default, 30px tall / xs font) / `medium` (33px / sm font, 35px pin) / `large` (36px / md font, 45px pin, wide large-type scenes); `sm`/`md`/`lg` are accepted aliases; a tier only changes the fallback of `--oas-badge-diagonal-*`, host custom properties take precedence; only takes effect with `ribbon-form="diagonal"`, invalid values silently fall back to `small`
attrs.rolled: End roll: a boolean modifier that adds a rolled edge to the protruding end (a large end radius + an inner gradient darkening that reads as a rolled cylinder; pure CSS). Composes with `fold` / `banner` / `flag`; other shapes silently ignore it
attrs.size: Size tier: small (compact, numeric badge ~13px tall, dot 6px) / medium (default, ~16px) / large (~20px, dot 10px); invalid values silently fall back to medium
attrs.status: Status point: `success` / `processing` / `default` / `error` / `warning`, renders an inline standalone element of "status dot + `text`", mutually exclusive with ribbon / dot / count modes (rendered first when set); the `processing` dot pulses (`prefers-reduced-motion` disables it)
attrs.text: Ribbon or status text; the `ribbon` slot takes precedence when it has content
attrs.value: Number
attrs.bordered: White outline: boolean, adds a 2px background-color ring around the badge (box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--oas-color-bg)) to separate it from an avatar/image background; visual-only, never changes positioning (composes with corner/offset/overlap)
attrs.icon: In-badge icon: a built-in icon name (e.g. check / warning), rendered as an inline SVG (1em following the badge font size, decorative and hidden from screen readers); mutually exclusive with value/dot (icon wins)
attrs.variant: Variant: solid (default, filled) or outline (transparent background, border and text follow the color semantics); invalid values silently fall back to solid
attrs.shape: Badge shape `round` (default) / `square` / `pill`, applying to both counts and dots

slots: Wrapped content (card, button, etc.); with no content the badge falls back to a standalone inline element

cssVars.--oas-badge-outline: Border and text color of the outline variant (the component injects the `-text` safe variant for semantic/preset `color`; falls back to the badge background color)

attrs.fixed: Pin to the viewport bottom (`position: fixed; bottom: 0`)
attrs.hide-on-scroll: Hide on scroll (requires `fixed`): slides out with `translateY(100%)` while scrolling down and slides back while scrolling up (a scroll delta >4px decides the direction; the transition animates transform only). A purely visual collapse without `aria-hidden` (tab semantics and keyboard focus stay reachable), restored on scroll-back; no effect when not fixed
attrs.layout: Layout mode: `stacked` (default, icon above text) / `horizontal` (icon left, text right, same row); invalid values fall back to `stacked` with a warning (deduped)
attrs.pill: Pill shape: turns the whole bar into a floating capsule (`tablist` fully rounded + a full outline replacing the top-only divider + a soft shadow; the host insets itself on both sides and, in `fixed` mode, leaves bottom spacing to float on all edges). Insets/shadow are exposed via the `--oas-bottom-navigation-pill-inset` / `--oas-bottom-navigation-pill-shadow` variables; dark theme follows tokens automatically
attrs.safe-area: Adds bottom safe-area padding (`env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`) in fixed mode to avoid the home indicator of notched screens; no effect in non-fixed mode
attrs.shift: Selected-item lift animation: the selected tab's icon lifts slightly (translateY(-2px)) and scales up (scale 1.08) with the label scaling up too, unselected items settle back; pure CSS transition (transform only, no layout impact), disabled under prefers-reduced-motion
attrs.show-label: Label display mode: `true` (default, all items show text) / `active` (icon-only compact mode: only the selected item shows text, unselected items show only the icon — each tab's accessible name is backed by an auto-written `aria-label` from the item label, unaffected by the CSS hide); invalid values fall back to `true` with a warning (deduped)
attrs.value: Value of the active item; defaults to the first available item

cssVars.--oas-glass-refraction: Liquid-glass edge refraction filter (active under `data-glass`, default none); for local opt-out override with an **empty** value (`--oas-glass-refraction: ;`)—not `none` (mixing `none` with button-state brightness() invalidates the whole filter declaration)

attrs.badge: Top-right corner badge (number/text overlaid on the icon; not rendered when unset)
attrs.value: Selection value (data-carrier field of the declarative child channel)
attrs.icon: Leading icon (`@oas-ui/icons` registry icon name)
attrs.disabled: Disable this item (not selectable, skipped by keyboard)

slots: Bottom-navigation item label content (default slot text)

attrs.open: Controlled open state (single source of truth). Shows the bottom panel and backdrop when open; gestures (drag handle / backdrop click / Esc) only emit oas-close requests — the host removes open to actually close (the component never mutates the controlled value)
attrs.max-height: Panel max height, default 85vh; overflowing content scrolls inside the panel
attrs.passive: Passive passthrough mode — hides backdrop and drag handle, disables overlay positioning and gestures; renders a static structure placeholder only (for overlay components PC-form reuse; SSR/client structure strictly identical)

events.oas-close: Close request; detail.reason is drag (handle dragged past threshold) / backdrop (backdrop click) / esc (Escape key). The component only emits — the host decides to close by removing open

attrs.active-last: Keep the last item clickable: when the current (last) item has `href`, render it as a link (still carrying `aria-current="page"`)
attrs.collapse-text: Custom text for the collapse ellipsis (default `…`)
attrs.collapsed: Collapse mode: when there are more items than `max-items`, middle items collapse into `…`; click to expand the dropdown
attrs.color: Visual variant: the current item and link hover use the specified semantic color (`primary`/`success`/`warning`/`danger`/`info`)
attrs.ellipsis: Single-line ellipsis: the breadcrumb never wraps; overflowing link text is truncated with an ellipsis
attrs.items-after-collapse: Number of items kept after the collapse ellipsis (default `max-items - 2`)
attrs.items-before-collapse: Number of items kept before the collapse ellipsis (default `1`)
attrs.max-item-width: Global max width per item (px): overflow is truncated with an ellipsis + `title` tooltip; per-item `maxWidth` overrides
attrs.max-items: Maximum number of visible items in collapse mode (including `…`); invalid values fall back to `4`
attrs.size: Size preset: `small`/`medium` (default)/`large`
attrs.variant: Style variant: `underline` (links and the current item are permanently underlined)

events.oas-select: A link item, a collapsed dropdown item, or an item dropdown item was clicked; `detail: { value: href }` (real links do not block default navigation; hosts may intercept for routing)
events.oas-collapse-click: Fired when the collapse ellipsis is clicked to expand the dropdown (not fired when collapsing), `detail: { collapsedItems }` (the original array of collapsed items, for hosts that want a custom collapse panel)

slots.separator: Custom separator content (text or icon; replaces the separator attribute)

attrs.disabled: Disabled item: rendered as non-interactive text (`aria-disabled`)

attrs.icon: Leading icon (`@oas-ui/icons` registry icon name)
attrs.max-width: Per-item max width (px): overflow is truncated with an ellipsis + `title` tooltip

slots: Breadcrumb item label content (default slot text)

attrs.autofocus: Autofocus: focuses the inner button on mount (native autofocus does not pierce Shadow DOM; the component forwards it)
attrs.block: Fill the full width of the parent container (block level)
attrs.wrap: Long-text wrapping: single-line nowrap by default; when enabled, content wraps within constrained widths and the box grows with it
attrs.ghost: Ghost/outline style: transparent background + outline colored by `type`, darkens on hover
attrs.icon: Icon name (reusing the oas-icon icon set); without text it becomes an equal-width square and uses the icon name as the fallback label
attrs.loading: Loading state
attrs.size: Size: `xs` / `small` / `medium` (default) / `large` / `xl`; invalid values fall back to `medium` with a warning
attrs.href: Link address: renders a native `<a>` when set
attrs.target: How the link opens (`_blank` / `_self` etc.), with `href`
attrs.plain: Plain style: low-contrast soft (transparent bg + softened text), equals `variant="filled"`
attrs.variant: Shape (orthogonal to `type`): `solid` (default filled) / `outlined` / `dashed` / `filled` (soft) / `text` / `link`
attrs.color: Custom color: overrides the `type` semantic color (any color value)
attrs.wave: Press feedback: slight sink + darken (on by default); `wave="false"` disables
attrs.auto-insert-space: CJK auto spacing: inserts a space between two consecutive CJK characters (off by default)
attrs.icon-end: A second icon after the text (built-in icon name), works with `icon`/`icon-position` — e.g. left icon + right dropdown arrow
attrs.loading-text: Text shown while loading (e.g. "Submitting…"); replaces the label content when set
attrs.disabled-focusable: Visually disabled but stays focusable/hoverable (aria-disabled + click intercepted), for tooltips explaining why
attrs.download: Passthrough `download` attribute in link mode (href) for file-download buttons
attrs.rel: Passthrough `rel` attribute in link mode (pair `noopener` with `target="_blank"`)
attrs.html-type: Native form behavior: `button` (default, none) / `submit` submits the containing or `form`-targeted form / `reset` resets it (bridged via a proxy submitter)
attrs.form: Associated form id for buttons outside the target form (native form-attribute association)
attrs.formaction: Target URL for this submission (overrides the form action)
attrs.formmethod: HTTP method for this submission (get/post/dialog, overrides the form method)
attrs.formnovalidate: Skip native validation for this submission only
attrs.formtarget: Browsing target for the response (_blank/_self etc., overrides the form target)

slots.description: Secondary text line (compound two-row variant): when present, the button switches to a vertical two-row layout (main row on top, secondary below, smaller muted text)
slots.loading-icon: Custom loading icon replacing the built-in spinner ring when slot content is present

cssVars.--oas-button-color-deep: Text-safe deepened variant of the custom `color`: the color-mix used for hover/active and outlined/dashed/filled text (injected by the component via `--oas-deep-mix` / `--oas-deep-sink`; inert without a custom color)

cssVars.--oas-glass-refraction: Liquid-glass edge refraction filter (active under `data-glass`, default none); for local opt-out override with an **empty** value (`--oas-glass-refraction: ;`)—not `none` (mixing `none` with button-state brightness() invalidates the whole filter declaration)

attrs.aria-label: Group container accessible name (defaults to the built-in i18n label)
attrs.size: Size passed to child buttons
attrs.value: Selected value (single value in single-select, comma-separated in multi-select)
attrs.pill: Pill shape: large rounding on the group outer edges (`--oas-radius-full` / `999px`)
attrs.spread: Buttons flex:1 to fill the container width evenly (mobile action bars / form footer button groups)
attrs.variant: Group-level variant passthrough to child buttons (set once, applies to all)
attrs.round: Group-level round passthrough to child buttons (set once, all capsule-rounded)

events.oas-change: Selection changed. Single-select `detail: { value }`; multi-select `detail: { value: [] }`

attrs.disabled: Globally disabled: greys out the calendar and stops all interaction (picking / paging / keyboard)
attrs.first-day-of-week: Week start override: `0` (Sunday) to `6` (Saturday); defaults to the locale (Monday for European/Chinese, Sunday for Japanese/Korean/English/Arabic)
attrs.max: Selectable range (ISO dates); navigation buttons grey out when the whole target page falls outside the range
attrs.min: Selectable range (ISO dates); navigation buttons grey out when the whole target page falls outside the range
attrs.mode: `month` / `year` (in year mode, picking a month auto-switches back to month view)
attrs.page-show-date: Panel month anchor (ISO `yyyy-MM` or `yyyy-MM-dd`): anchors the displayed month initially/on change, taking precedence over value; removing it falls back to the value month
attrs.readonly: Read-only: page navigation and panel drill-down stay available, but picking dates / Enter does not commit
attrs.show-week-number: Show the ISO week number column
attrs.value: Selected value (ISO)
attrs.range: Range selection mode: two-click picking with hover preview and range highlighting; oas-change carries `{ start, end }`; value mirrors a JSON array
attrs.locale: Panel language override (title/weekdays/cell descriptions/nav copy/week start); defaults to config-provider > global
attrs.format: Header title format string (yyyy/MM/dd tokens; day/month panels)
attrs.calendar-system: Non-Gregorian calendar (Intl calendar option, e.g. chinese/islamic/hebrew): title, weekday headers, cell numbers and aria descriptions follow it; date math and value/data-date stay Gregorian
attrs.months: Number of side-by-side month panels (1-12, default 1): panels lay out horizontally and paging steps the whole strip; the title shows the month range
attrs.events: Scheduled items (JSON): [{ date: YYYY-MM-DD, title?, color? }] — marker dots per day (uses color if given, else primary), +N badge beyond 2; hover/focus opens an inline items popover

events.oas-cell-render: Dispatched when each day cell renders, `detail: { date, element }` (element is the day button; host can append markers/badges/rich content)
events.oas-mode-change: Dispatched when year mode auto-switches back to month view after picking a month, `detail: { mode }`
events.oas-panel-change: Dispatched when the displayed panel month changes due to user paging/month picking/jumps, `detail: { date }` (date is the first day of the new page)

slots.template[slot=\"cell\"]: Static template for day cells, cloned into each day button; the `[data-cell-date]` node is bound to the day number
slots.header: Custom header replacing the built-in navigation (built-in kept when not distributed)

props.events: Scheduled items (`CalendarEvent[]`, `{ date, title?, color? }`): `el.events` reads the effective items; `el.events = [...]` writes programmatically (syncs the events attribute and re-renders, no event)

attrs.clickable: Whole card clickable (focusable; click / Enter / Space dispatch `oas-click`)
attrs.cover-src: Cover image URL placed at the top of the card (object-fit: cover)
attrs.hoverable: Whether to enable the hover shadow (shadow + lift + pointer)
attrs.title: Card title (rendered into the visible title region; absorbed from the host on read so no native hover tooltip remains; pass an empty string to clear); use the "title" slot for rich content
attrs.loading: Loading state: content area swaps to skeleton rows (aria-busy synced)
attrs.size: Size: `small` (compact padding, smaller title) / `medium` (default)
attrs.variant: Variant: `outlined` (default, bordered) / `borderless` (embedded, no border)
attrs.header-bordered: Header divider line (default true; `"false"` hides it)
attrs.shadow: Shadow: `none` / `hover` (lift on hover) / `always`; `hoverable` maps to `hover`, explicit shadow wins
attrs.description: Meta secondary text (muted line under the title; dual channel with the description slot, slot wins)
attrs.href: Link card: whole card acts as a link (wrapped in an internal anchor; keyboard/middle-click native)
attrs.selectable: Selectable card: click the card body (or press Enter/Space) to toggle the selected state and dispatch `oas-change`; interactive elements inside the card (buttons/links) do not trigger selection; with `href`, selecting takes precedence over navigation; not selectable while `loading`
attrs.selected: Selected state (with `selectable`): setting it from the host makes the card controlled — the component only dispatches `oas-change` and never mutates the attribute itself (the host writes it back); when unset, the component toggles internally and reflects this attribute (uncontrolled)
attrs.disabled: Disables the card: graying + aria-disabled + no interaction events + href stripped (selected look preserved)
attrs.orientation: `horizontal` places the cover left (40% width, full height) with a right-hand content column

events.oas-change: Selected state toggled (when `selectable`), detail is `{ selected }` (the new state after the toggle)

slots.actions: Bottom action area (view / edit / delete button groups), with a divider above
slots.cover: Custom cover content (mutually exclusive with `cover-src`, which takes precedence)
slots.extra: Extra area on the right of the title
slots.title: Rich title content slot; overrides the title attribute text when present
slots.avatar: Meta avatar slot (left side of the header; with description forms the avatar+title+subtitle header)
slots.description: Rich Meta secondary content (mutually exclusive with the description attribute, slot wins)
slots.footer: Independent footer strip (separate from the actions area)

attrs.arrows: Arrow display mode: `always` (always shown) / `hover` (shown on hover) / `never` (hidden)
attrs.effect: Transition effect: `slide` (default) / `fade` (stacked cross-fade, degrades to instant under reduced-motion)
attrs.indicator-position: Indicator position: `inside` (default, overlaid) / `outside` (in-flow, grows the container)
attrs.loop: Loop around (default on; `"false"` stops at the edges and disables the corresponding arrow)
attrs.pause-on-hover: Pause autoplay on hover/focus (default true; `"false"` disables; always pauses when the page is hidden)
attrs.pause-button: Show an explicit pause/play button (default off; click toggles autoplay pause/resume and takes priority over hover pausing; clicking play while autoplay is off enables it)
attrs.slides-per-view: Slides per page (default 1; index is page-based, last page aligns to the track end)
attrs.type: Carousel layout type: `"card"` enables card mode — the current card is centered as the main body with neighboring cards peeking on both sides (scaled down, dimmed); clicking a neighbor card switches to it directly; mutually exclusive with `slides-per-view`/`effect`/`direction` (card mode wins); card width/gap/neighbor scale via `--oas-carousel-card-width` / `--oas-carousel-card-gap` / `--oas-carousel-card-scale`
attrs.draggable: Pointer/touch drag switching: flip past 25% of the viewport or on a quick flick, spring back otherwise; on by default on touch devices, off on PC; `"false"` disables explicitly
attrs.trigger: Indicator activation: `click` (default) / `hover` (hover switches, click still works)
attrs.thumbs: Replaces dots with a thumbnail strip (sources from a JSON array / data-thumb / child img); the current thumbnail gets a primary-color border

attrs.show-all-levels: Show the full path (default true); `false` shows only the leaf
attrs.value: Path array (JSON), e.g. `["zj","hz"]`
attrs.multiple: Multi-select (cascading checkboxes; fully-checked children roll the parent into the value)
attrs.check-strictly: Decouple parent/child checking in multi-select (checking a parent does not cascade)
attrs.expand-trigger: Sub-level expansion trigger: `click` (default) / `hover` (120ms delay to prevent misfires)
attrs.size: Size preset `small` / `medium` (default) / `large`
attrs.status: Validation status: `error` / `warning` / `success`; error mirrors aria-invalid
attrs.open: Controlled open state (single source of truth); in the mobile form (touch / viewport <768px) the open panel is hosted by an oas-bottom-sheet bottom sheet (swipe-down/backdrop/Esc to close); desktop keeps the floating dropdown
attrs.max-tag-count: Collapse multi-select tags beyond the count into +N (with title listing hidden items)
attrs.loading: Loading state: trigger spinner + aria-busy; the panel shows a loading placeholder
attrs.field-names: Field-alias JSON (`{ label, value, children, disabled }`) matching the tree-select contract; lazy-load results are mapped alike
attrs.label: Accessible name of the trigger (aria-label), taking priority over value/placeholder
attrs.placement: Panel placement in 12 directions (invalid falls back to bottom; auto-flip kept)
attrs.virtual: Per-column virtual scrolling (columns above 50 items render via oas-virtual-list; short columns/search/loading keep normal rendering)
attrs.item-height: Fixed virtual row height in px (with virtual, default 36)

events.oas-clear: Fires on clear-button click; `detail` is the pre-clear value
events.oas-focus: Dispatched on trigger focus; `detail.value` shares the oas-change shape (inner focus moves do not false-fire)
events.oas-blur: Dispatched on trigger blur; `detail.value` shares the oas-change shape (inner focus moves do not false-fire)

slots.template[slot=\"option\"]: Custom option row template; `[data-option-label]` nodes bind the option text
slots.template[slot=\"suffix-icon\"]: Custom trailing trigger icon (replaces the default arrow; yields to the spinner while loading)

props.value: Current value: the selected path array, or an array of selected paths when `multiple`

attrs.aria-label: Chart description (falls back to locale by type)
attrs.data: Data. Array single-series `[{label, value}]` or object multi-series `{labels, series:[{name, data, type?, yAxisIndex?}]}` (series-level `type` / `yAxisIndex` for combo and dual-axis)
attrs.options: Config: `smooth` (smoothing), `colors` (series palette), `showLegend`, `gradient` (area-chart vertical gradient fill, default false), `max` (radar global scale), `radarShape` (radar grid `polygon`/`circle`, default polygon), `yAxis` (dual-axis array; dual axis requires the second entry AND series bound on both sides via yAxisIndex, otherwise single axis)
attrs.type: Chart type: `line` / `bar` / `pie` / `area` / `donut` / `stacked-bar` / `radar` / `polar-area` (combo has no type value — override per series via `series.type`)

attrs.indeterminate: Indeterminate state (visual only; clicking still toggles the two-state value; aria-checked syncs to mixed)
attrs.value: Option identifier
attrs.size: Size: `small` (14px) / `medium` (default 16px) / `large` (18px), box and font scale together; a group-level value cascades to items while an explicit item value wins
attrs.status: Validation status: `error` / `warning` / `success` (tints the box; error also sets host aria-invalid)
attrs.readonly: Readonly: focusable and Tab-reachable, value still submits, but clicks (and Space) never toggle (distinct form semantics from disabled)
attrs.variant: Variant: `default` / `card` (whole block clickable, selected border tint, hover feedback)
attrs.description: Secondary text rendered below the label; a `slot="description"` distribution takes priority
attrs.label-position: Label position: `end` (default, box left / text right) / `start` (text left; mirrors automatically in RTL)
attrs.check-all: In-group select-all marker: clicking toggles all items, item changes write back its checked/indeterminate state; the item never joins the group value (cross-component attribute read by oas-checkbox-group)
attrs.required: Required marker (drives the native valueMissing validation chain; not passed through to the inner input)
attrs.true-value: Mapped value when checked: drives detail.value, the value getter and FormData submission (not effective inside a checkbox-group)
attrs.false-value: Mapped value when unchecked (detail.value / value getter; not added to FormData per native unchecked semantics; not effective inside a checkbox-group)
attrs.tabindex: Forwarded to the inner native checkbox (`-1` removes it from the tab order)

events.oas-limit-blocked: Group count-limit block signal (the group re-dispatches it as oas-exceed-limit; no such block when used standalone)

slots.checked-icon: Custom checked indicator (template[slot] or a direct element; unchecked falls back to the default hollow outline)
slots.indeterminate-icon: Custom indeterminate indicator (pairs with check-all linkage)
slots.description: Description distribution channel (takes priority over the description attribute)

attrs.language: Language: `js`/`ts`/`html`/`css`/`json`; unknown falls back to plain text
attrs.inline: Inline code mode: renders as a monospace light-background box for code snippets inside prose
attrs.word-wrap: Wrap long code instead of horizontal scrolling
attrs.trim: Strip leading/trailing whitespace (default true; `trim="false"` preserves it)
attrs.size: Inline font-size tier: `xs` / `small` / `medium` (default) / `large`; invalid values fall back to `medium` with a warning
attrs.variant: Inline style: `subtle` (default light background) / `outline` (bordered) / `plain` (text only) / `solid` (filled); invalid values fall back to `subtle` with a warning
attrs.color: Inline text color: accepts 11 preset names (`magenta` / `red` / `volcano` / `orange` / `gold` / `lime` / `green` / `cyan` / `blue` / `geekblue` / `purple`, mapped to `--oas-preset-*-text` tokens) or any CSS color value
attrs.highlight-lines: Line highlight: `"1,3-5"` range syntax for highlighted lines (1-based)
attrs.focus-lines: Line focus: focused lines stay, the rest dim
attrs.diff: Diff mode: colors lines by leading `+`/`-` (semantic color tokens)
attrs.max-rows: Max visible lines; overflow folds with an expand/collapse tail row (`0` = unlimited)

attrs.accordion: Accordion mode; only one panel open at a time
attrs.variant: Variant: `outlined` (default, bordered rounded container) / `borderless` (ghost, no border)
attrs.icon-placement: Expand icon placement: `start` (left of title) / `end` (default, right); overridable per item
attrs.default-active: Uncontrolled initial expanded set (comma-separated `name`s): first-frame seed, then self-managed; controlled when `active` is present
attrs.heading-level: Panel heading semantic level `1`-`6` / `none` (default): 1-6 attaches heading role + aria-level (a11y)

events.oas-before-collapse: Fired before expand/collapse (cancelable), `detail: { name, next }`; `preventDefault()` blocks the toggle (not fired by expandAll/collapseAll)

attrs.name: Unique identifier of the panel
attrs.open: Whether it is expanded (managed by the container)
attrs.disabled: Disable the panel: not focusable, not clickable (expandAll skips it)
attrs.no-collapse: Lock the expanded state: clicking itself does not collapse (other panels unaffected)
attrs.destroy-on-collapse: Destroy panel content on collapse (re-mounted on next expand; collapse animation skipped)
attrs.force-render: Render panel content up front (collapsed content is not rendered by default)
attrs.icon-placement: Per-item override of the container icon placement (`start` / `end`)
attrs.heading-level: Per-item override of the heading semantic level (`1`-`6` / `none`)
attrs.summary: Collapsed-state summary: shown at the header tail while the panel is collapsed (report the inner value without expanding, e.g. "12px 4px"), hidden when expanded; single line with ellipsis truncation; carries no heading semantics

slots.header: Rich panel header (mutually exclusive with the header attribute, slot wins; interactive children should stopPropagation)
slots.extra: Panel header right-side action area (clicks inside do not toggle)
slots.template[slot=\"toggle\"]: Custom expand icon template (built-in arrow by default)

attrs.placement: Panel placement, 12 directions: `top`/`bottom`/`left`/`right` with `-start`/`-end` (default `bottom`); auto right-aligns when the trigger nears the viewport right edge, flips upward when space below is insufficient, and clamps back inside the viewport
attrs.value: Current color (hex)
attrs.clearable: Show a "clear" button in the panel footer (visible when open and a value is set): writes back `value-on-clear` or empties `value`, then emits `oas-clear` + `oas-change`
attrs.color-format: Output format: `hex` (default) / `rgb`; determines the value written back and the trigger text format
attrs.disabled-alpha: Disable the alpha slider (effective when `show-alpha` is on)
attrs.inline: Inline mode: the panel renders in place always visible with the trigger hidden, no popup positioning contract, no `oas-open-change`
attrs.mode: Picking mode: `single` (default) / `gradient` (gradient editor; requires the designer capability — silently inert with a one-time dev warning when missing)
attrs.open: Controlled panel visibility (boolean attribute); ineffective while `readonly`/disabled; emits `oas-open-change` on change
attrs.preset-columns: Preset swatch column count (positive integer, default 8)
attrs.preset-rows: Preset swatch row cap (positive integer; unset shows all presets)
attrs.readonly: Read-only: the trigger cannot open the panel and all edits are blocked
attrs.show-alpha: Enable the alpha channel: alpha slider in the panel, checkerboard under translucent trigger/preset swatches, alpha included in the value output
attrs.show-text: Show the color text on the trigger (default true; `"false"` shows the swatch only)
attrs.size: Trigger size: `small` / `medium` (default) / `large`
attrs.uppercase: Uppercase the output color value (hex letters A–F)
attrs.value-on-clear: Fallback value on clear: clicking clear writes this back instead of emptying `value`
attrs.recent: Recent-colors strip: each committed color is pushed onto a deduped, 8-capped, newest-first stack shown as clickable swatches
attrs.recent-key: localStorage key used to persist recent colors (with recent; memory-only when omitted)

events.oas-clear: Emitted after "clear" is clicked; `detail: { value }` holds the previous value; `oas-change` follows (detail.value is the new value / empty string)
events.oas-open-change: Emitted when panel visibility changes, `detail: { open }` (not emitted in inline mode)

slots.trigger: Custom trigger (replaces the default swatch button)

props.value: Current value: the color string (read from the controlled `value` attribute)

attrs.clearable: Clearable (shows a clear button when a value exists; clearing dispatches `oas-clear`)
attrs.filterable: Filter labels in real time while typing (`filterable="false"` disables local filtering)
attrs.item-height: Virtual-scroll fixed row height (px, with `virtual`, default 36)
attrs.loading: Loading placeholder (dropdown shows "加载中…")
attrs.open: Controlled open state (internal open/close writes back to the attribute; every transition dispatches `oas-open-change`; forced closed under readonly/disabled); in the mobile form (touch / viewport <768px) the open panel is hosted by an oas-bottom-sheet bottom sheet (swipe-down/backdrop/Esc to close); desktop keeps the floating dropdown
attrs.options: Options, JSON array `[{ label, value, disabled?, group? }]` (group is the group title, same contract as oas-select)
attrs.readonly: Readonly (focusable & copyable, no value change; focus and keyboard never open the dropdown)
attrs.size: Size tier: small / medium / large (default medium, follows the nearest config-provider injection)
attrs.status: Validation status: success / warning / error (error syncs aria-invalid, drivable by oas-form-item validation)
attrs.value: Current value (controlled, the selected option's `option.value`; a JSON array string under `multiple`)
attrs.virtual: Virtual scroll (reuses oas-virtual-list to render only the visible window; options with group fall back to full rendering)
attrs.required: Required marker (drives the native valueMissing validation chain; not passed through to the inner control)
attrs.autocomplete: Passed through to the inner native input (falls back to off)
attrs.multiple: Multi-select mode (mirrors oas-select multiple semantics: the value is a JSON array, selected options render as removable tags, the panel stays open after each pick for continuous selection; typing only filters, free-text semantics are off)
attrs.max-count: Multi-select limit (only with `multiple`): once reached, unselected options are greyed out and blocked with `oas-exceed-limit`; selected options can still be removed
attrs.max-tag-count: Tag collapse count (only with `multiple`): when explicitly set, tags are laid out on one line and the overflow collapses into `+N` (title lists the folded labels); without it tags wrap by default
attrs.name: Form field name (key for native FormData submission; also the key of same-name multiple entries in multiple mode; the browser skips submission when name is absent)

events.oas-change: Selection/clear/removal change; single `detail: { value }`; multiple `detail: { value: string[], options: Array<Option|null> }` (mirrors the oas-select multiple contract)
events.oas-clear: Clear button clicked; single `detail: { value }` (value before clearing); multiple `detail: { value: string[] }` (array before clearing)
events.oas-open-change: Open state transition (both controlled setAttribute and internal toggles dispatch), `detail: { open }`
events.oas-exceed-limit: Selection attempt beyond the multiple max-count limit, `detail: { value, max }`

props.filter: Custom filter function (property channel, `(input, option) => boolean`)
props.value: Current value: single is the selected value string (falls back to the typed draft when nothing is selected); `multiple` is the array of selected values

attrs.block: Width 100% (stretch to fill the parent container)
attrs.vertical: Vertical grouping (adjacent items overlap -1px vertically, corner merging switches to top/bottom)
attrs.aria-label: Override the group accessible name: the component sets role=group with an i18n default name (locale `compact.group`); setting this attribute overrides it

attrs.items: Command items JSON (root page; sub-pages via `item.page`, supports `icon` / `shortcut` / `description` / `page` / `view` / `forceMount` / `separator` fields)
attrs.open: Whether open (controlled; auto-removed after selection / Esc; fires `oas-open-change` on open and close)
attrs.value: Search query (controlled; two-way via `oas-input` echo-back)
attrs.selected: Active item value (controlled; arrow keys / hover fire `oas-active` for the host to echo back)
attrs.hotkey: Invocation shortcut combos, e.g. `ctrl+k` / `meta+shift+p` (comma-separated for multiple; supports mod/meta/ctrl/alt/shift); `false` disables the built-in listener (default `mod+k`)
attrs.should-filter: `false` disables built-in filtering and score sorting (filtering delegated to the host, for async/server data sources)
attrs.loading: Async loading placeholder (loading row in the list + `aria-busy`)
attrs.limit: Max rendered items (default `50`; not applied in virtual mode)
attrs.recent: Track recently used (selected items pinned to top, deduped, capped at 10)
attrs.recent-storage-key: localStorage key for recent persistence (requires `recent`; restored across instances)
attrs.close-on-select: Close the panel after selecting (default true; `false` keeps it open for consecutive actions)
attrs.multiple: Multiple-select mode (toggle checks + batch run via the footer confirm button)
attrs.virtual: Virtual scrolling for large datasets (reuses oas-virtual-list)
attrs.append-to: Mount container selector (e.g. `#panel`): the whole panel (backdrop + palette) moves into a portal host inside the target container (isolated shadow + style injection + slot bridging — empty/footer/view-* slots travel with the panel), for nested transform/stacking-context scenarios; without it the panel is fixed-positioned inside the component's own shadow

events.oas-select: A command was executed, `detail: { value }`; multi-select confirm `detail: { values }`
events.oas-input: Search input, `detail: { value }` (request channel for `should-filter=false` external filtering)
events.oas-active: Active item changed, `detail: { value }` (basis for controlled `selected` echo-back)
events.oas-page-change: Sub-page pushed/popped, `detail: { title, depth, direction }` (`direction: push|pop`)

slots.empty: Custom empty state (read the current query via `el.query`, e.g. a "create xyz" entry)
slots.footer: Custom footer bar (defaults to `↑↓ navigate / ↵ select / esc close` hints)
slots.view-${view}: Per-view override of the selected content (host writes `<div slot="view-deploy">` …; `view` is the view field value)

attrs.show-value: Display the current value below the knob (formatted via the `formatValue` function / `format` template / `unit` suffix, same source as `aria-valuetext`)

attrs.loading-text: Custom loading placeholder copy (defaults to locale)

attrs.track-color: Track base color: preset semantic names map to theme tokens; any other value is passed through as a CSS color

attrs.label: Accessible name for the inner slider (range mode appends localized min/max suffixes)

attrs.label-2: Accessible name for thumb 2 (multi-thumb mode; takes precedence over labels/label)
attrs.label-3: Accessible name for thumb 3 (multi-thumb mode; takes precedence over labels/label)
attrs.label-4: Accessible name for thumb 4 (multi-thumb mode; takes precedence over labels/label)

attrs.show-track: Track visibility switch (shown by default); show-track="false" hides the track bar and selection fill (the thumb remains draggable and keyboard operable)

attrs.lineless: Hide all connector lines (boolean; enabled when present; compact look)
attrs.max-count: Maximum number of visible steps (minimum 2): when exceeded the middle collapses into ellipsis steps (⋯, not clickable, connector lines stay continuous); the first/last/current steps are always visible and the window slides with current; invalid values / below 2 are ignored (show all)
attrs.navigation: Navigation mode: arrow bar with a bottom Previous/Next button row (boolean; enabled when present; mutually exclusive with `simple`, simple wins)
attrs.progress-dot: Progress-dot steps: dot indicators with a thin connector line (boolean; enabled when present; mutually exclusive with `simple`, simple wins)
attrs.responsive: Responsive vertical: renders in the vertical layout when the container width is below 640px (boolean; enabled when present; ResizeObserver, cleaned up on disconnect; ignored under navigation)
attrs.reverse: Visual reversal: horizontal `row-reverse` / vertical `column-reverse`; displayed number = total - index (increasing along the visual flow), status derivation still follows the steps array order (boolean; enabled when present)
attrs.separator: Connector style: `line` (default) / `dashed` (dashed border) / `arrow` (trailing arrowhead); not applied under navigation / arrow
attrs.simple: Compact mode: single-row small size (smaller indicators, hidden descriptions, tighter connector lines) (boolean; enabled when present; takes priority over progress-dot/navigation)

attrs.steps: `[{ title, description?, status?, icon?, disabled?, extra?, id?, loading?, optional?, percent?, prefix? }]` JSON string
attrs.size: Five type-density tiers (indicator/connector geometry constant; aliases accepted)

cssVars.--oas-steps-item-bg: Segment background for the current status (color-mix per status)

attrs.title: Hover hint text (full title / supplementary note) — passed through to the shadow tab button as a native hover tooltip; tabs absorb and remove it from the panel host (so the panel content area never shows a native tooltip); the items JSON `title` field works the same way

attrs.bordered: Full border: draws a grid outline around cells (the outer frame is built in)
attrs.checkable: Row selection: present = multi-select (checkboxes + select-all header); `="radio"` = single-select (mutually exclusive, click again to deselect, no select-all), oas-check detail.keys ≤1
attrs.columns: Column config `[{ key, title, sortable?, width?, align?, fixed?, render?, summary?, editable?, editor?, editOptions?, editComponent?, actions?, type?, currency?, options? }]`, JSON string (declarative attribute channel; property assignment takes precedence); `type` declares the field type (number/currency/select/multi-select/date/checkbox/link/progress/rate) driving default cell rendering and the default editor, `currency` is the currency symbol for currency columns (default ¥), `options` are select/multi-select options `[{ value, label, color? }]`
attrs.data: Row data `[{ [key]: value, children?, expand? }]`, JSON string (declarative attribute channel; property assignment takes precedence)
attrs.editable: Inline editing switch (requires `editable: true` on columns; same for the `actions: true` operation column)
attrs.edit-controlled: Controlled editing: does not write back `data` on submit, only fires `oas-edit`; the host listens and updates `data` itself
attrs.expanded: Set of expanded row keys (comma-separated; shared by tree parent rows and expandable rows)
attrs.height: Virtual scroll viewport height (px); when set, only visible-window rows plus head/tail placeholders are rendered
attrs.loading: Loading state: shows placeholder rows in the data area (header retained)
attrs.row-height: Fixed row height for virtual scrolling (px)
attrs.row-key: Unique key field of a row
attrs.sticky-rows: Number of sticky rows (N): the first N rows stick below the header (coexists with the scroll container and fixed columns)
attrs.stripe: Zebra striping: alternating light background for odd/even rows
attrs.summary: Summary config `[{ key, type: 'sum'|'avg'|'count', label? }]`, JSON string
attrs.size: Density preset: `small` / `medium` (default) / `large` — only changes default cell padding and font size (all via CSS variables; override with `--oas-table-cell-padding-block` / `--oas-table-cell-padding-inline` / `--oas-table-font-size`, which take precedence); invalid values fall back to `medium` with a warning; orthogonal to `row-height`
attrs.column-keys: Controlled column visibility and order (key array or comma list): header tree and data columns re-order to the effective leaf order (same-ancestor leaves grouped)
attrs.filter-values: Controlled column filter values (JSON object: column key → selected values)
attrs.multi-sort: Multi-column sort (JSON array: [{ key, order }], applied in array order)
attrs.pagination: Built-in pagination switch (footer pager; leave unset when the host paginates)
attrs.summary-scope: Summary aggregation scope: `all` (default, full dataset) / `page` (current page)
attrs.show-header: Toggles the header (default true); with `false` no header row is rendered while column configuration still aligns data cells
attrs.table-layout: Passes the table layout algorithm through (with `fixed`, column widths strictly follow `width`)
attrs.hover: Row hover background switch (purely visual), `"false"` disables
attrs.indent-size: Per-level indent of tree data in px
attrs.max-height: Caps the body scroll area with a sticky header (virtual `height` wins when both set)
attrs.exportable: Enables export: renders export buttons in a toolbar above the table (CSV by default, CSV/Excel configurable), and exposes the exportData method
attrs.export-format: Export format: `csv` (default) / `excel`, or the comma list `csv,excel` (both buttons); invalid falls back to csv
attrs.export-file-name: Export file name (without extension; path separators and reserved characters are sanitized)
attrs.grid-navigation: Keyboard grid navigation: role=grid, single Tab stop for the data region, arrow keys roam cells (Home/End/PageUp-Down, Enter/Space activate in-cell controls)
attrs.row-draggable: Row drag sorting: renders a drag-handle column and dispatches oas-row-reorder on drop; disabled with a warning under virtual scrolling
attrs.column-virtual: Column virtualization (column windowing): only visible-window columns render; off-window columns collapse into placeholder cells (colSpan-summed via colgroup). Constraints: explicit width on all columns recommended; grouped header / span-method / summary rows incompatible (warns and degrades)
attrs.group-by: Grouped view: render sections by field value (section header = value + row count + collapse arrow, click to collapse/expand, expanded by default); groups ordered by first occurrence, sorting applies within groups; empty values fall into the "(empty)" group; combined with merge columns / span-method / row-draggable it warns once and degrades to plain rendering; works with column-virtual / virtual scrolling (section header spans the full width)
attrs.cell-tooltip: Cell overflow tooltip (on by default, `"false"` to disable): when a plain-text cell overflows (scrollWidth > clientWidth), hover shows the full text in a floating layer — one table-level singleton tooltip (token inverse colors, readable in dark mode), auto-hidden on scroll/re-render; rich-content cells and ellipsis columns with a native title are exempt (no double tooltip)

events.oas-edit: Inline edit submitted (Enter / blur / operation column save), `detail: { rowIndex, key, column, value }`; in controlled mode the component does not write back `data`
events.oas-edit-cancel: Inline edit cancelled (Esc / operation column cancel / empty submit restores), `detail: { rowIndex, key, column, value }` (`value` is the original value)
events.oas-expand: Row expand/collapse (tree child rows or expandable content rows), `detail: { key, expanded }`

events.oas-scroll: Virtual scroll event (rAF throttled), `detail: { scrollTop, start, end }`
events.oas-column-order: Fired after column drag reorder, `detail: { keys }` (new column order)
events.oas-column-resize: Fired after a column width drag, `detail: { key, width }`
events.oas-filter-change: Fired when a column filter value changes, `detail: { key, values }`
events.oas-page-change: Fired when the built-in page changes, `detail: { current, pageSize }`
events.oas-cell-click: Fired on data-cell click, `detail: { row, column, value, rowIndex, columnIndex }` (suppressed inside interactive controls)

events.oas-export: Export triggered (button or exportData), `detail: { format, fileName, rowCount }`

slots.template[slot=\"empty\"]: Rich empty-state content (takes precedence over empty-text and the default empty text)
slots.template[slot=\"filter-icon\"]: Custom filter trigger icon in filterable column headers

attrs.summary: Column participates in the summary row (sum/avg/count)
attrs.title: Column header title (defaults to the default slot text)
attrs.width: Column width (px or CSS value; fixed columns should declare it explicitly)

attrs.size: Tab size: `xs/small/medium/large/xl` (default medium), font-size/padding follow the step; invalid values fall back to medium with a warning
attrs.justified: Distribute tabs evenly across the full tab bar width
attrs.without-scroll-controls: Disable the overflow scroll arrows (shown by default when tabs overflow)
attrs.more: Collapse overflowed tabs into a "More" dropdown instead of scroll arrows (mutually exclusive); the More button highlights when the active tab is collapsed

attrs.trigger: Switch trigger: `click` (default) / `hover` (switch on hover; disabled tabs not triggered)

attrs.hide-indicator: Hide the active indicator line (the ::after underline in line mode)
attrs.scroll-position: Scroll alignment when scrolling the active/added tab into view: `auto` (default nearest) / `start` / `center` / `end`

attrs.hide-content: Pure navigation mode: render the tab bar without the panel area (tabs act as a nav strip; the host takes over content/routing)
attrs.items: Data-driven rendering: JSON array `[{ label, value, icon?, badge?, disabled?, href?, target?, rel?, closable?, editable?, iconOnly? }]`; takes precedence over `oas-tab-panel` children when both present
attrs.context-menu: Right-click action menu on tabs (New / Close / Close others / Close all to the left / Close all to the right / Close all; New fires oas-add, each close fires oas-close once per target tab)
attrs.tabindex: Forwarded to every tab button, overriding roving (removing restores it; disabled stays -1)

events.oas-add: The + button was clicked, `detail: { label }` (default new-tab label from locale; use it or customize it)
events.oas-close: A tab's close × was clicked, `detail: { key }` (`key` is that tab's `value`; the component does not remove the panel)
events.oas-before-change: Fired before switching (cancelable), `detail: { value }`; host `preventDefault()` vetoes the switch (click/keyboard both; direct setAttribute by host does not trigger)
events.oas-rename: Editable tab rename confirmed via double-click + Enter, `detail: { value, label }`; the component writes the new label back to the panel, host may persist
events.oas-reorder: Fired after sortable drag reorder, `detail: { fromIndex, toIndex }`; host reorders `oas-tab-panel` accordingly (the component does not move DOM itself)

slots.icon: Icon content for a tab item (replaces the panel's icon attribute)
slots.label: Label content for a tab item (not projected through the panel's default slot)
slots.actions: Action area fixed at the right of the tab bar, outside the scrollable tablist (after the + button when addable; no space when empty)

attrs.checkable: Selectable: click / Enter / Space toggles `checked` and dispatches `oas-change`; mutually exclusive with `closable`
attrs.color: Custom color: 11 preset names (`magenta` / `red` / `volcano` / `orange` / `gold` / `lime` / `green` / `cyan` / `blue` / `geekblue` / `purple`, mapped to `--oas-preset-*` tokens) or any CSS value, overrides the `type` semantic color; renders as `filled` when `variant` is unset
attrs.dot: Status dot before the text (8px, color follows `type` / `color`)

attrs.href: Link URL: renders a native `<a>` when set

attrs.max-width: Max width of the tag content (e.g. `120px`); overflow is truncated with an ellipsis; with `multiline` it only constrains the width so content wraps
attrs.multiline: Multiline: content wraps (auto height + vertical padding compensation); with `max-width` content wraps instead of being truncated
attrs.size: Size: `xs` / `small` / `medium` (default) / `large` / `xl`; invalid values fall back to `medium` with a warning

attrs.close-icon: Custom close-button icon (built-in icon name), replaces the default ×

attrs.loading: Loading state: spinner replaces the close icon and blocks clicks (`oas-close` detail has a `done()` callback the host calls after async work)
attrs.checked-icon: Checkmark icon before a checked checkable tag (built-in icon name, default check)
attrs.icon-end: Icon-set name (oas-icon icon name) rendered at the tail of the text (before the close button), sized to the font; can coexist with icon

cssVars.--oas-tag-color: Text color: the `color` attribute feeds through this variable; `--tag-color` is the component's internal current color, falling back to text-primary when unset
cssVars.--oas-tag-color-deep: Text-safe color (`deep` level): drives both the text color of `filled`/`outlined` and the **solid background** of `solid`/`checked`, falling back to text-primary when unset

attrs.aria-label: Accessible name of the group container (defaults to i18n "Tag group")
attrs.disabled: Disables the whole group (children cannot toggle)
attrs.multiple: Multi-select mode (`value` holds comma-separated selected values)
attrs.value: Selected value: a single value for single-select, comma-separated for multi-select

attrs.depth: Text softening tier: `1` / `2` / `3` (progressively lighter); only effective with `type="default"`
attrs.weight: Font weight: `regular`/`medium`/`semibold`/`bold` (compatible with the strong boolean)
attrs.numeric: Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) for aligned numeric columns in tables/stats
attrs.size: Three font-size presets mapped to font-size tokens (medium falls back to inherited size)

slots.actions: Action slot (copy/edit buttons etc.); position determined by `actions-position`

attrs.readonly: Readonly
attrs.value: Value (controlled)
attrs.maxlength: Maximum length (native passthrough; pair with show-count)
attrs.show-count: Show character count (bottom-right n/max; turns red over limit; aria-live announced)

attrs.size: Size preset `small` / `medium` (default) / `large`
attrs.variant: Variant: `outlined` (default) / `filled` / `borderless`
attrs.clearable: Show a clear button (one-click clear; fires oas-clear + oas-input)
attrs.label: Accessible name (aria-label channel; falls back to placeholder → locale)
attrs.name: Form field name (native passthrough)
attrs.autocomplete: Passed through to the inner native textarea

events.oas-clear: Fires when the clear button is clicked (oas-input also fires)

props.value: Current value: the inner textarea text (`el.value` reads; `el.value = x` writes the controlled `value` and syncs, no event)

attrs.token: Custom list of tokens to edit (CSS variable names)
attrs.preset: Built-in preset theme: `compact` (tight; control-height -4px, space scaled down proportionally) / `comfortable` (roomy; +4px, space scaled up proportionally) / `default` (equivalent to reset; clears written inline variables). Invalid values are ignored with a dev warning

attrs.clearable: Clearable: shows a clear button when a value exists; emits `oas-clear` + `oas-change` (empty value)
attrs.format: Display format tokens; a column appears only when the corresponding token exists
attrs.is-range: Time range: value is a JSON array `["HH:mm:ss","HH:mm:ss"]`, auto-ordered on confirm; the typing channel is read-only in this mode

attrs.placement: Popup placement, 12 directions (default `bottom-start`), `fixed` + collision flipping + viewport clamping (same contract as date-picker)
attrs.readonly: Readonly: the panel can be opened and browsed, but no interaction commits

attrs.status: Validation status: `success` / `warning` / `error` (`error` also sets `aria-invalid`)

attrs.label: Accessible name (aria-label) for the trigger; an external label-for association takes precedence

events.oas-confirm: Emitted on confirm actions (Enter / outside click / Now, alongside `oas-change`)

attrs.spread: Full-width equal split (aligned with button-group spread)

attrs.arrow: Whether to show the arrow (default true; `arrow="false"` hides it, the element and `::part(arrow)` are kept)
