attrs.arrow-position: Arrow shape: `center` (default, arrow centered on the panel edge) / `merge` (only for `*-start`/`*-end` placements; a right triangle merges flush with the panel corner — legs collinear with the panel edges, tip pointing orthogonally toward the anchor)
attrs.auto-adjust-overflow: Viewport-edge auto flip and avoidance (default true; `"false"` disables it, keeping the declared placement, which may overflow the viewport)
attrs.auto-close: Auto-close after opening (ms); `0` or absent disables it
attrs.close-delay: Hide delay (ms, default 0): close after mouseleave/focusout
attrs.collision-padding: Viewport-edge avoidance margin (px, default 4): the distance kept from the edge when the popup is clamped
attrs.color: Color variant: semantic `primary`/`success`/`warning`/`danger`, one of the 11 preset names (e.g. `magenta`, `blue`), or any CSS color. All go through tokens (with dark variants); the arrow background follows
attrs.content: Tooltip content text (the `slot="content"` rich content takes precedence when present)
attrs.disabled: Disabled: the tooltip never shows (neither hover nor a controlled `open`)
attrs.fresh: Content freshness (default true): content changes are synced immediately even while closed; `"false"` freezes the content while closed, updating on next open
attrs.interactive: Hoverable popup: moving the mouse into the popup keeps it open (`pointer-events: auto`), links inside stay reachable
attrs.max-width: Popup max width (number in px or CSS length; defaults to the `--oas-tooltip-max-width` token, 240px)
attrs.offset: Main-axis distance (px, default 10): the gap between the popup and the anchor along the main axis
attrs.open: Controlled display (boolean attribute; shows when present)
attrs.open-delay: Show delay (ms, default 0): open after mouseenter/focusin; skipped when `skip-delay-duration` hits
attrs.skidding: Cross-axis offset (px, default 0): top/bottom placements shift horizontally (positive right, negative left); left/right placements shift vertically (positive down, negative up)
attrs.skip-delay-duration: Global delay-group threshold (ms, default 300): when a tooltip closes, the next one opened within this window skips its open-delay and shows immediately (responsive for consecutive hovers); `"0"` disables it
attrs.touch-delay: Touch long-press trigger duration (ms, default 500): with `touch` in `trigger`, pointerdown held to the threshold opens; releasing/moving out earlier cancels
attrs.trigger: Trigger modes (space-separated multi-select): `hover` / `focus` / `click` / `contextmenu` / `touch` / `manual`, default `hover focus`; `manual` is fully controlled
attrs.trigger-keys: Specified keys (space-separated, e.g. `F1`): pressing one while the trigger is focused opens the tooltip
attrs.virtual: Virtual trigger mode: not bound to a host trigger element; `open` is fully controlled externally and the position is set by `virtual-anchor` or `virtual-x`/`virtual-y` (for chart points, floating hints during drag)
attrs.virtual-anchor: Anchor element selector (e.g. `#chart-point-1`); the tooltip is positioned by that element's rect. Mutually exclusive with `virtual-x`/`virtual-y` (coordinates take precedence)

attrs.virtual-y: Virtual anchor viewport Y coordinate (px, e.g. mouse `clientY`); position by coordinates when set together with `virtual-x`

attrs.follow-cursor: Follow the cursor: once open, positioned at the cursor coordinates (zero-size point); cursor movement is tracked with rAF throttling
attrs.width: Popup width: a number (px) / `"trigger"` (same width as the trigger) / any CSS value; still capped by `--oas-tooltip-max-width` (default 240px)

attrs.status: Validation status: `error` / `warning` / `success`

events.oas-step-validate: After a per-step validation; `detail: { index, key?, valid, errors }`
events.oas-skip: When an optional step is skipped; `detail: { index, key? }` (skipping never validates; the skipped step leaves the values/validation scope until revisited)
events.oas-submit: Finished on the last step (all participating steps validated); `detail: { values }` (merged across participating steps only — hidden / skipped steps excluded)
events.oas-values-change: Natural bubble-through of the inner oas-form value changes (`detail: { name, value, values }`, values is that step's snapshot); use getValues() for the merged view

slots.step-<key>: Step content panel (keyed steps); place one `<oas-form>` inside to carry the step's fields and rules
slots.step-<index>: Step content panel (unkeyed steps associate by array index)

attrs.clickable: Steps are clickable to jump (default true; `clickable="false"` disables: click/keyboard silent, arrow focus still works)
attrs.current: Current step index (0-based, two-way: jumps write it back, external sets instantly sync aria-selected and panel visibility); invalid values fall back to 0, out-of-range clamped
attrs.linear: Linear mode: only steps with `index <= current` can be activated (future steps `aria-disabled` + visually weakened, silent on click/keyboard)
attrs.size: Size tier: `xs`/`small`/`medium`/`large`/`xl` (title font density; invalid values fall back to medium + dev warning, deduped)
attrs.steps: Steps data JSON `[{ title, description?, icon?, disabled?, status? }]` (semantics aligned with oas-steps StepItem minus panel-unrelated fields); invalid/empty fall back to `[]`

events.oas-change: Fired when jumping to a clickable step (step click / keyboard Enter/Space); `detail: { index }` (0-based, bubbles + composed, writes back current)

slots: Content panel projection area (`<oas-stepper-panel>` direct children); panels are associated with step indexes by `value`, only the one matching `current` is visible

attrs.value: Step index string the panel is associated with (e.g. `value="0"`); only the panel matching `current` is visible (`hidden` driven by oas-stepper)

attrs.local: Mount target container selector (CSS selector/HTMLElement); defaults to a global bar at the top of body
attrs.reverse: Reverse direction (RTL progress flows right to left)
attrs.speed: Base advance speed (ms, default 200); start(speed) overrides
attrs.status: Current status: loading/finish/error (activity query)

events.oas-error: Dispatched when error() finalizes in the error state

attrs.type: Shape: `text` (default) / `title` / `avatar` / `button` / `input` / `image` / `rect`; invalid values fall back to text
attrs.width: Width (CSS value), overriding the per-type default
attrs.height: Height (CSS value), overriding the per-type default

attrs.disabled: Disable the whole group (cascades to items without overriding their own explicit disabled)
attrs.options: Data channel: JSON `[{ label, value, disabled?, description?, checkAll? }]`; when explicit, data-driven rendering wins over declarative children
attrs.max: Selection cap: at the cap unchecked items gray out and block with oas-exceed-limit; checked items can still be unchecked

attrs.size: Size (cascades to items): `small` / `medium` (default) / `large`
attrs.status: Validation status (cascades to items): `error` / `warning` / `success`

events.oas-exceed-limit: Out-of-cap check attempt after max is reached, `detail: { value, max }`
events.oas-focus: Any item inside the group gained focus (moves between items do not misfire)
events.oas-blur: Fired when focus leaves the group

slots: Declarative item channel (`<oas-checkbox>` children; steps aside when options is explicit)
slots.label: Group title (rendered into the legend)

props.value: Current value: array of checked value strings (equivalent to parsing the `value` attribute JSON)

events.oas-focus: Any item inside the group gained focus (moves between items do not misfire)

attrs.mixed: Mixed-color indicator (mosaic, for merged multi-value scenarios)

attrs.whole-word: Whole-word matching (off by default; Unicode letter/digit boundaries)

events.oas-count: Dispatched after each recompute, `detail: { count, matches }`

attrs.name: List root path (bare field names are auto-prefixed as `name.N.field`)
attrs.max: Row cap (adding is disabled at the cap)

events.oas-add: Dispatched when a row is added, `detail: { index }`
events.oas-remove: Dispatched when a row is removed, `detail: { index }` (remaining rows renumber, values stay with their rows)

slots: Row template (the first template element without a slot attribute; field names use `{index}` or are auto-indexed)

attrs.events: Schedule events (JSON): [{ id?, date: YYYY-MM-DD, title, color?, start?, end? }] — chips rendered in day cells (title + color bar), collapsed to +N beyond 2
attrs.page-show-date: Panel month anchor (controlled): yyyy-MM-dd; re-anchors the shown month on change
attrs.first-day-of-week: First day of week (0-6); defaults to locale-derived
attrs.locale: Localization (overrides config-provider injection and global locale)
attrs.view: View: month (default) / week / day / agenda; week/day views show a time axis with positioned event blocks (untimed events go to the all-day row); agenda shows a 28-day chronological list
attrs.end-hour: Time axis end hour (> start-hour and <= 24, default 20)
attrs.timezone: Timezone (IANA, e.g. Asia/Shanghai; empty = local): affects title/column date formatting and the today marker (via Intl timeZone); invalid values fall back to local

events.oas-day-click: Dispatched when an empty day cell is clicked, detail: { date } — host attaches an add form
events.oas-event-click: Dispatched when an event chip is clicked, detail: { id, event } (does not trigger the day click)
events.oas-events-change: Dispatched on any events change (set/addEvent/updateEvent/removeEvent), detail: { events }
events.oas-view-change: Dispatched on view switch (month/week/day/agenda), detail: { view }; not dispatched on initial attribute absorption
events.oas-remind: Dispatched when an event reminder is due, detail: { id, event } (fires at start - remind minutes via built-in timers)

props.events: Schedule events (`SchedulerEvent[]`): `el.events` reads (copy incl. auto ids); `el.events = [...]` writes (syncs the events attribute + re-renders + dispatches oas-events-change)

attrs.tasks: Gantt tasks (JSON): [{ id?, name, start, end?, type?, progress?, parent?, children?, dependencies?, color?, disabled?, expanded? }] — flat parent pointers are the primary contract; nested children are flattened automatically; explicit type:"milestone" takes precedence (rendered as milestone even with end, which is ignored) but a task with children is always a summary; no end also infers milestone; start/end are swapped automatically when start is after end
attrs.scale: Time scale: hour / day (default) / week / month / quarter / year; invalid values fall back to day
attrs.expanded: Expanded set (JSON array, controlled): defaults to fully expanded when absent; explicit [] collapses all; written back on toggle
attrs.readonly: Whole chart read-only (no rescheduling/progress, drag handles not rendered)
attrs.show-today: Today line (on by default; false to disable)
attrs.weekends: Weekend column highlights (on by default; applies on day/hour tiers; false to disable)
attrs.holidays: Holiday list (JSON ["YYYY-MM-DD",…]): matching columns highlighted (takes precedence over weekend tint)
attrs.first-day-of-week: Week start day (0-6); defaults to locale derivation (used for week-tier alignment)
attrs.locale: Localization (overrides config-provider injection and the global locale)
attrs.label-position: Bar label position: inside / right / left; default `none` (the row-name column already shows the name, so the bar does not repeat it); invalid values fall back to `none`
attrs.snap: Snap drags to the current scale unit (on by default; false shifts by pixel ratio and keeps time precision)

events.oas-task-click: Dispatched on task bar/milestone click, detail: { id, task }
events.oas-task-dblclick: Dispatched on task bar double-click, detail: { id, task } — hosts attach an edit form
events.oas-task-change: Dispatched when a drag/resize/keyboard reschedule settles (pointerup), detail: { id, task, oldStart, oldEnd, start, end }; not dispatched on zero movement
events.oas-progress-change: Dispatched when a progress handle drag settles, detail: { id, task, progress }
events.oas-tasks-change: Dispatched on task data change (programmatic tasks write / updateTask / drag write-back), detail: { tasks }
events.oas-expand-change: Dispatched on row tree collapse/expand, detail: { id, expanded }
events.oas-scale-change: Dispatched when the scale attribute changes, detail: { scale }; not dispatched on initial absorption
events.oas-task-render: Dispatched after each task bar renders, detail: { task, element } — hosts may rewrite bar DOM

slots.template[slot=\"task\"]: Task bar label template (cloned into the bar; [data-task-name] nodes get the task name)

props.tasks: Gantt tasks (`GanttTask[]`): `el.tasks` reads (copy; nested input already flattened to parent pointers); `el.tasks = [...]` writes (syncs the tasks attribute + re-renders + dispatches oas-tasks-change)

attrs.columns: Independent column data (JSON array [{ key?, label?, items: [{ label, value?, disabled? }] }]; mutually exclusive with options and takes priority)
attrs.item-height: Row height in px (positive integer, invalid values fall back to default)
attrs.options: Cascading tree data (JSON [{ label, value?, children: [...] }]); column count derives from selection path, parent change rebuilds child columns and resets to first enabled item
attrs.value: Selected values per column (JSON array; item value falls back to label); written back on settle, programmatic writes only scroll without firing events
attrs.visible-count: Visible row count (≥3, even values round up to odd)
attrs.name: Native form field name (form-associated: the FormData submission key; value is a JSON array string)
attrs.required: Required marker (drives the native valueMissing validation chain: unselected counts as unfilled)

events.oas-change: Fired after scroll/keyboard selection settles (not fired on programmatic value writes). detail { value, labels, columnIndex }—value/labels reflect all columns, columnIndex is the changed column

attrs.loading: Typing state (boolean presence): content switches to a three-dot typing indicator and the host reflects aria-busy (the AI "typing" scenario)

attrs.name: File name (title channel; renders media only without error when absent)
attrs.detail: Secondary metadata (type · size); in the error state with no detail, shows the localized failure text ("Upload failed"); an explicit value is kept
attrs.state: Upload state machine: idle / uploading / processing / error / done (default done; vocabulary matches oas-upload; uploading/processing reflect aria-busy)
attrs.progress: Upload progress 0–100 (clamped; the thin bottom progress bar with role=progressbar renders only while uploading)
attrs.size: Three size steps: default / sm (accepts the small alias) / xs, tightening padding and media per step
attrs.orientation: Layout direction: horizontal (default) / vertical (media above text, for narrow columns)
attrs.href: When set, the whole card becomes a clickable trigger (a[part=trigger]) and clicks dispatch oas-open; host preventDefault takes over and blocks default navigation
attrs.downloadable: Boolean presence: shows the built-in download button (clicking dispatches oas-download; the download itself is host-owned)
attrs.removable: Boolean presence: shows the built-in remove button (clicking dispatches oas-remove; the component never removes itself — removal is a host decision)

events.oas-open: Dispatched when the href card trigger is clicked, detail { href }; cancelable — host preventDefault also blocks the anchor default navigation
events.oas-download: Dispatched when the built-in download button is clicked, detail { name }
events.oas-remove: Dispatched when the built-in remove button is clicked, detail { name }; never self-removes

slots.actions: Appends custom actions (after the built-in download/remove buttons)
slots.media: Media slot (icon/thumbnail); any slotted content overrides the built-in default glyph

attrs.auto-scroll: AI-style bottom follow (boolean presence, off by default): follows streaming growth only while the reader is at the bottom (near-bottom ≤ edge-threshold); scrolled-up reading is never interrupted
attrs.pin-to-bottom: IM-style always pinned (boolean presence): new content always scrolls to the bottom, pulling readers back; wins when combined with auto-scroll
attrs.default-position: Opening position: start (top) / end (bottom, default; invalid values fall back to end) / last-anchor (top of the last anchor-marked message — the AI "return to the last question" scenario; falls back to end with no anchor)
attrs.edge-threshold: Bottom detection threshold in px (default 8) — within the threshold of the bottom counts as at-bottom (near-bottom detection)
attrs.label: Overrides the viewport accessible name (locale "Messages" by default; absorbed into the viewport and removed from the host — global-attribute absorption convention)
attrs.preserve-scroll-on-prepend: Compensates scrollTop when older messages are prepended to keep the reading position (on by default; explicit ="false" disables) — settles precisely by the pre-insertion first-node displacement (same-frame append+prepend mixes settle only the top insertion), then locks a preservation anchor: async resources (images etc.) growing the upper history keep being compensated by the anchor's viewport drift (message-id re-queried first)
attrs.turn-anchor: Turn anchoring (boolean presence): one question+answer exchange is the anchoring unit — while the anchor sits at the viewport top the last anchor-marked message is pinned at prev-peek from the top with answers flowing in beneath; bottom following continues at the bottom; scrolled-up readers are never pulled
attrs.prev-peek: Context px revealed above the anchor top during turn-anchor alignment (default 64; invalid/negative values fall back to 64)

events.oas-scroll-state: Dispatched when scrolling crosses a decision line, detail { atBottom, atTop, canScrollStart, canScrollEnd }; an initial state is broadcast once on the first frame (after initial positioning) — received even when the host attaches its listener after the upgrade

slots: Message rows (oas-message-row / oas-marker etc.; the anchor / message-id attributes on rows are scroller cooperation markers)
slots.button: Custom jump-to-bottom button content (replaces the built-in arrow glyph; visibility and click remain component-owned; default is the built-in part=button)

attrs.variant: Variant: default (small secondary text), border (outlined pill row), separator (stretching lines both sides of the text — the primary time-divider form); empty content hides default/border entirely while separator keeps the line

slots.icon: Decorative icon slot (wrapper is aria-hidden; streaming/progress status is declared by the host via role=status, not duplicated by the component)

attrs.align: Direction: start (theirs, default) / end (mine) — logical properties (row-reverse + logical alignment), mirrored automatically in RTL
attrs.status: Delivery status convenience attribute: sending / sent / delivered / read / error — renders visible text + decorative icons (localized copy; meaning never rides on color alone; error adds danger color as enhancement); invalid/absent values render no status area
attrs.grouped: Boolean presence: consecutive message from the same sender (declared by the host), tightening row spacing via --oas-message-gap

slots.avatar: Avatar slot (bottom-aligned; long messages hug the bottom)
slots.footer: Footer slot (actions/extra metadata, aligned with direction)

attrs.theme: Surface: charcoal (default, constant-ink surface) / dark (constant ink · deep) / light (theme-native); constant-ink surfaces use the --oas-color-ink* semantic tokens and do not flip with the host theme; invalid values fall back to charcoal with a one-time warning

slots: Command area (oas-action-bar-button or any command control)
slots.center: Readout well area (oas-action-bar-well + well children; pushed to the far end of the writing direction)

attrs.value: Command identifier (carried in the oas-action detail)
attrs.active: Selected state (controlled display — the host listens to oas-action and writes back; the component does not toggle itself)
attrs.active-tint: Selected highlight color: the 11 preset names resolve to --oas-preset-*; any CSS color is injected as-is (e.g. record-red #e11d48); text contrast is the host’s responsibility
attrs.plain: No fill within groups (selected state only tints the text)
attrs.disabled: Native disabled passthrough (unclickable, unfocusable; aria-disabled kept in sync)

events.oas-action: Dispatched on click; detail { value, active } — active is the state at click time; bubbles + composed

attrs.max-width: Well max width (number, px; default 320; invalid values ignored, negatives clamp to 0)

slots: Well content (oas-statistic-well / oas-task-progress-well or host-defined readouts)

attrs.side: Panel side: right (default) / left (divider-direction semantic hook only; positioning is decided by host layout); invalid values fall back to right with a one-time warning
attrs.density: Density tier: default (row height 28px) / compact (row height 24px, tightened spacing, delivered to children via tokens); invalid values fall back to default with a one-time warning
attrs.empty: No-selection state: the default slot hides and the empty slot (built-in "No selection" copy by default) shows
attrs.label: Accessible name (falls back to the i18n "Inspector" default)
Label text (the label area hides when empty)
attrs.value: Read-only value (key-value row; tabular numerals)
attrs.mixed: Multi-selection mixed state: shows the built-in "Mixed" copy, value yields
attrs.reset: Shows a row-level reset button that dispatches oas-row-reset

slots: Control channel (slotted content switches the row to a 50/50 control row; without it the row is a read-only key-value row; form controls are provided by the host with their own accessible names)

attrs.heading: Section title (also the fold button’s aria-label)
attrs.name: Section name (carried in the oas-toggle detail; empty string by default)
attrs.collapsible: Enables folding (plain non-collapsible title by default)
attrs.open: Expanded state (attribute-as-state — click toggles and reflects; hosts may coordinate by listening to oas-toggle)
attrs.default-open: Expands initially (uncontrolled convenience: writes open on the first frame when absent)

events.oas-toggle: Dispatched when the fold button is clicked; detail { name, open }; bubbles + composed

slots.extra: End-of-header action area (decoupled from the fold click)

attrs.items: JSON [{ label, value, disabled? }] (attribute declarative channel); invalid JSON renders empty with a one-time warning
attrs.value: Current tab (attribute-as-state — the component updates and reflects it on switch; hosts may coordinate by listening to oas-change)

events.oas-change: Dispatched when the selected tab changes; detail { value }; bubbles + composed

attrs.label: Readout label (hides when empty)
attrs.value: Readout value (tabular numerals)

attrs.label: Accessible name (falls back to the i18n "Status bar" default)

slots.end: Right-segment status cells (secondary/context items, pushed to the far end of the writing direction)

attrs.value: Numeric / status value (rendered in tabular numerals)
attrs.label: Text label
attrs.icon: Built-in icon name (@oas-ui/icons registry; unknown names render nothing)
attrs.button: Renders as a native button (clickable, keyboard reachable); read-only div semantics by default
attrs.status: Semantic color tier: default / info / warning / error / progress — warning/error use background fills (reserved for special, necessary cases), info/progress only tint the text; invalid values fall back to default with a one-time warning

events.oas-item-click: Dispatched on click in button mode; detail { value, label }; bubbles + composed (listenable on the container or the host)

attrs.label: Task name (hides when empty)
attrs.progress: Progress 0-100 (controlled display — host-driven, the component does not self-advance; out-of-range clamps, invalid falls back to 0); progress 100 keeps the finished state, the component does not remove itself
attrs.detail: Supplementary info (speed / time remaining etc.; hides when empty)

events.oas-cancel: Dispatched when the cancel button is clicked; detail { label }; the component only emits — it does not remove itself, the host decides what follows

attrs.size: Height tier: compact (default, 34px) / large (68px, controls stay compact); invalid values fall back to compact with a one-time warning
attrs.drag: Turns the whole bar into a window drag region (writes -webkit-app-region: drag + data-tauri-drag-region, effective in Electron/Tauri hosts; harmless no-op in plain Web); interactive children automatically opt out (no-drag), [data-no-drag] opts out explicitly
attrs.title: Centered title text (overridden when slot="title" has content). attrs.subtitle: Subtitle / document state (last edited time etc.)
attrs.editable: Makes the document-well title editable: Enter or blur commits (dispatches oas-title-change and updates the absorbed cache), Esc cancels and rolls back; rewriting title externally while editing terminates the edit
attrs.window-actions: Built-in window action button subset (comma-separated: minimize,maximize,close); clicking dispatches oas-window-action — the component does not perform window operations
attrs.leading-inset: Safe area: leading-side native-control clearance (CSS length; also settable via --oas-titlebar-leading-inset)
attrs.trailing-inset: Safe area: trailing-side native-control clearance (CSS length; also settable via --oas-titlebar-trailing-inset)

events.oas-title-change: Dispatched when the document well commits (Enter/blur) with a changed value; detail { title }; the absorbed cache is updated (the title attribute does not stay on the host)
events.oas-window-action: Dispatched when a built-in window action button is clicked; detail { action } (minimize/maximize/close); the component only emits — hosts wire Electron/Tauri APIs

slots.leading: Custom area before the title (brand / macOS traffic lights provided by the host)
slots.center: Central interactive content channel (overrides the title / document well when present, e.g. document tag combos)
slots.title: Rich title channel (overrides the title attribute text)
slots.trailing: End-of-bar custom area (beyond the window action buttons)

attrs.header: Trigger text (rendered inside the trigger button; rich content via slot="header", slot wins)
attrs.disabled: Disables the trigger: not focusable, not clickable, emits no events; the config-provider global disabled injection applies as well

slots.header: Rich trigger content slot, overrides the header attribute text
slots.template[slot=\"toggle\"]: Custom toggle icon template (built-in arrow by default)
